import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";
import { issueComments } from "./issue_comments";
import { reports } from "./reports";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "reportable_type" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const issues = defineTable("issues", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        reportableType: col.text().notNull(),
        reportableId: col.integer().notNull(),
        reportedUserId: col.integer(),
        status: col.enum(["open", "ignored", "resolved"], { name: "issue_status_enum" }).notNull().default("open"),
        assignedRole: col.enum(["administrator", "moderator", "importer"], { name: "user_role_enum" }).notNull(),
        resolvedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        resolvedBy: col.integer(),
        updatedBy: col.integer(),
        reportsCount: col.integer().default(0),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        updatedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        reportedUser: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        resolvedByRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { localKey: "resolved_by", onDelete: "no action" }),
        updatedByRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { localKey: "updated_by", onDelete: "no action" }),
        issue_comments: rel.hasMany(() => issueComments),
        reports: rel.hasMany(() => reports)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
